Since web standards take a long time to be adopted across the different browsers, polyfills are used to enable new JavaScript functionality in older browsers. In most cases, they are written in older JavaScript (ECMAScript) standards to maintain compatibility with the older browsers. For example, if you are using the latest version of JavaScript and your site needs to be compatible with older browsers, you must use polyfills.

What is a polyfill?
